column1: # Fixed biome regression probes for the High (0.5 degree) grid.
# Expectations are the values the locked sources actually support, verified against
# the Koppen-Geiger V3 1991-2020 class and the ETOPO 2022 60" cell mean for the cell
# that contains the coordinate. A lookup floors the coordinate into its cell, whose
# centre sits on a .25/.75 half-degree, so a probe written on a whole degree reads
# the cell just south-east of it. Coordinates are stable; do not retune an
# expectation to mask a build regression, and state evidence only for the cell that
# was actually checked rather than generalising to a whole mountain range.
